notes: Georgia’s electors voted on December 8 instead of the legal day, December 1, but Congress counted their 11 votes for Hancock anyway. Without them he would have had 144.

California split its electoral votes, 5 for Hancock and 1 for Garfield. Voters chose electors individually, and enough Democratic voters passed over elector David S. Terry that one Republican elector won.
In Virginia, the Democrats ran two elector slates, Funder and Readjuster, both pledged to Hancock. His vote there combines the two.

DE.note: APP and the Delaware article (official returns, counting the top elector on each ticket) both give Hancock 15,181, Garfield 14,148 and 29,458 votes cast. The article's top Weaver elector had 121, not the file's 120, plus 8 scattering, which makes up the rest of APP's total; the Tribune Almanac 1881 and the main 1880 article still have the file's 14,133 and 15,275.
